title: Pdfalyzer: pypdf has possible large memory usage when parsing cross-reference streams (CVE-2026-119209)
description: CVE-2026-119209 is a vulnerability in the pdfalyzer tool (pypdf library) that allows an attacker to craft a PDF file with cross-reference streams causing large memory usage when parsed. This can lead to denial of service due to resource exhaustion. The issue affects versions starting from 1.16.1. A fix is available in pypdf version 6.21.3. If upgrading is not immediately possible, applying the changes from the referenced pull request #4269 is recommended as a workaround.
